name: normalizeEmail
contract: Trim surrounding whitespace and lowercase the entire email.

name: isVitEmail
contract: Accept only nonempty local parts at exactly vit.ac.in or vitstudent.ac.in.

name: validTeamSize
contract: Team size is an integer in the inclusive interval 1..max.

name: parseSeats
contract: Accept only a positive safe integer written as decimal digits; invalid values return null.

name: validRegistration
contract: Registration numbers contain exactly two digits, three letters and four digits; ignore case and edge whitespace.

name: uniqueMembers
contract: Deduplicate members by normalised email while preserving the first original record.

name: validateCoordinates
contract: Latitude is in [-90,90], longitude in [-180,180]; both must be finite numbers.

name: requiredFields
contract: Return missing field names; numeric zero and boolean false are present values.

name: searchEvents
contract: Search name, description and tags, case-insensitively; blank query returns all.

name: filterByTag
contract: An event must match ALL selected tags; no tags means no filtering; tag matching ignores case.

name: sortByStart
contract: Return events by ascending start instant without changing the input array.

name: paginate
contract: Pages are one-based; return at most size items; pages beyond the data are empty.

name: availableEvents
contract: Availability counts only confirmed seats, never waitlisted or cancelled seats.

name: registrationOpen
contract: Registration is open at opensAt and closed at closesAt; compare absolute instants.

name: findEvent
contract: Find by trimmed case-insensitive ID, returning null for an unknown ID.

name: distinctTags
contract: Return sorted unique lowercase tags across all events.

name: occupiedSeats
contract: Sum only confirmed seats for the requested event.

name: canReserve
contract: Positive whole-seat requests may exactly fill remaining capacity.

name: cancelBooking
contract: Cancel only the matching booking; retain every other record and do not mutate the input.

name: promoteWaitlist
contract: Scan waitlist in input order, skip non-fitting parties, and never promote beyond free seats.

name: duplicateBooking
contract: A same-event, normalised-email booking blocks duplicates unless cancelled.

name: remainingSeats
contract: Remaining capacity never becomes negative.

name: eventBookings
contract: Scope the booking list by eventId, not booking ID.

name: teamReady
contract: Team readiness requires enough distinct members and acceptance from every member.

name: subtotal
contract: Line subtotal is unit paise times quantity, summed across all items.

name: discountAmount
contract: Clamp percentage to 0..100 and round the calculated discount to integer paise.

name: couponValid
contract: Coupons require active=true, startsAt <= now < expiresAt and subtotal >= minimum.

name: taxAmount
contract: Tax basis points use 10000 = 100%; round once to integer paise.

name: totalDue
contract: Clamp subtotal less discount at zero, then add tax.

name: refundAmount
contract: Refund is 100% at >=48 hours, floor(50%) at >=24 hours, otherwise zero.

name: splitCost
contract: Split integer paise evenly; assign one extra paise to the first remainder people.

name: formatINR
contract: Display paise as rupees with exactly two decimal places.

name: availableQuantity
contract: Available equipment excludes reserved and damaged units, clamped at zero.

name: reserveItems
contract: Add a validated reservation to existing reserved quantity for the matching item.

name: releaseItems
contract: Release reserved quantity without going below zero.

name: lowStock
contract: An item is low stock when usable availability is at or below the threshold.

name: bomRequirements
contract: Bill-of-materials demand equals per-team quantity multiplied by team count.

name: canFulfill
contract: Every requirement must have enough available units; an empty requirement list is fulfillable.

name: restock
contract: Add delivered units to existing stock; preserve other records.

name: equipmentCost
contract: Equipment cost sums unit paise times required quantity; unknown items contribute zero.

name: overlaps
contract: Use half-open intervals: adjacent sessions do not overlap.

name: durationMinutes
contract: Return elapsed minutes across date boundaries, using the explicit time-zone offsets.

name: sortSessions
contract: Sort by absolute instant rather than the written local date/time.

name: conflicts
contract: Return each same-venue overlapping pair once in input order.

name: minutesUntil
contract: Countdown rounds any positive partial minute up and clamps past sessions to zero.

name: withinWindow
contract: The entire session must fit inside the window; equal endpoints are allowed.

name: shiftSession
contract: Shift both start and end by minutes, preserving duration and extra fields.

name: dayIndex
contract: Event days are one-based elapsed 24-hour blocks measured from event start.

name: mean
contract: Arithmetic mean; an empty series returns zero.

name: peak
contract: Maximum sample; an empty series returns zero.

name: movingAverage
contract: Trailing moving average includes the current point and at most window-1 preceding points.

name: integrateDistance
contract: Trapezoidal speed integration converts millisecond intervals to seconds; output is metres.

name: batteryPercent
contract: Use linear interpolation between supplied min/max voltages, clamp to 0..100 and round.

name: verticalVelocity
contract: Successive altitude differences divided by positive elapsed seconds; nonpositive intervals yield zero.

name: outliers
contract: Flag deviations strictly beyond threshold on either side of the mean; retain original indexes.

name: downsample
contract: Keep indexes 0, stride, 2*stride, and so on for a positive integer stride.

name: revenue
contract: Revenue includes paidPaise of confirmed bookings only.

name: occupancyPercent
contract: Occupied seats divided by capacity as a rounded percentage; zero capacity gives zero.

name: uniqueParticipants
contract: Count distinct normalised emails across confirmed bookings.

name: groupByEvent
contract: Group all bookings under eventId, preserving record order.

name: completionPercent
contract: Task completion is rounded and clamped to 0..100; nonpositive total gives zero.

name: median
contract: Numeric median; even-length lists average the two central values; empty gives zero.

name: topEvents
contract: Rank by descending totals; break ties by ascending ID and limit result length.

name: csvCell
contract: CSV cells containing quotes, commas or newlines are quoted and internal quotes doubled.

name: parseSnapshot
contract: Only object snapshots are accepted; invalid JSON, arrays, null and primitives use a cloned fallback.

name: migrateSnapshot
contract: Migrate v1 quantity to v2 seats, preserving an existing seats value and every unrelated field.

name: upsertById
contract: Merge updates by ID with incoming fields winning; append unknown IDs; preserve unrelated fields.

name: removeById
contract: Remove only the requested ID and clone retained records.

name: cacheFresh
contract: Freshness is 0 <= age < TTL; future-dated entries are not fresh.

name: patchPreferences
contract: Only theme, pageSize and eventId can be patched; explicit falsy values are retained.

name: mergeSnapshots
contract: Merge by ID, choosing the greatest numeric updatedAt; incoming wins ties; preserve first-seen ID order.

name: retainAudit
contract: Keep the last limit audit entries in chronological input order; nonpositive limit gives empty.
